name: com.gamecore.reference-seams
description: Test-only compiled reference seam from Wave 0 (GC-002). It freezes the shared GameCore.Contracts compile-time surface so Wave 1 tasks can compile in parallel; the W1 gate replaces this package with com.gamecore.contracts without a surface change. Its assembly is deliberately named GameCore.Contracts so consumers reference it by the production assembly name.
